summary: The coverage gap is preexisting. On both sides, the unchanged parser depth limit prevents the old harness from supplying a value deep enough to exercise the dump behavior at that depth.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established this dump coverage obligation; timing compares the same deep-value route on both source versions.

before.requirement: Exercise dumping of a supported constructed value deep enough to reach depth JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH. Before g0005, do_dump recursively handled that depth without the new rejection.
before.reason: The old harness obtains dump values only from json_loadb. The unchanged parser rejects values deeper than its limit, while dumping starts the root at depth zero; the harness constructs no deeper value.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged parser rejects a value beyond its depth limit.
Parsing starts the root from depth zero.
Dumping starts the root at depth zero.

after.requirement: Exercise the g0005 rejection when dumping a supported constructed value reaches depth JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: The new guard is present, but the same unchanged parser limit prevents a successfully loaded value from reaching it. The harness still has no value-construction step.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The same parser depth limit remains in force.
Parsing still starts the root from depth zero.
Dumping still starts the root at depth zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The parser depth check and the harness's parse-then-dump-only setup are identical on both sides. g0005 adds a rejection behind that existing constraint.
